Metabase Query Reference

Run this query in Metabase, export as CSV, then share with Claude to update the dashboard.

SELECT 'active_cardholders' AS metric,
  COUNT(DISTINCT b1.borrowernumber) AS value
FROM categories AS c1
LEFT JOIN categories_branches cb ON cb.categorycode = c1.categorycode
LEFT JOIN borrowers AS b1 ON c1.categorycode = b1.categorycode
  AND b1.branchcode = 'BERTWP'
  AND DATE(b1.lastseen) >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 12 MONTH)
WHERE (cb.branchcode IS NULL OR cb.branchcode = 'BERTWP')
UNION ALL
SELECT 'new_cardholders_last_month', COUNT(*)
FROM borrowers
WHERE branchcode = 'BERTWP'
  AND categorycode NOT IN ('STAFF', 'LIB')
  AND dateenrolled >= DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE() - INTERVAL 1 MONTH, '%Y-%m-01')
  AND dateenrolled <  DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y-%m-01')
UNION ALL
SELECT 'new_items_last_month', COUNT(*)
FROM items
WHERE homebranch = 'BERTWP'
  AND dateaccessioned >= DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE() - INTERVAL 1 MONTH, '%Y-%m-01')
  AND dateaccessioned <  DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y-%m-01')
UNION ALL
SELECT 'total_checkouts_last_month', COUNT(*)
FROM statistics
WHERE branch = 'BERTWP'
  AND type = 'issue'
  AND datetime >= DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE() - INTERVAL 1 MONTH, '%Y-%m-01')
  AND datetime <  DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y-%m-01');

Score = % of items checked out in last 12 months
Metabase Query Reference

Run these queries in Metabase, export as CSV, then share with Claude to update the dashboard.

SELECT
    main.ccode,
    main.total_items,
    main.on_loan,
    main.circ_12mo,
    main.dead_items,
    main.never_circd,
    main.avg_lifetime_circ,
    COALESCE(weed.weed_eligible, 0)  AS weed_eligible,
    COALESCE(lost.missing_lost, 0)   AS missing_lost
FROM (
    -- ── Core health stats ───────────────────────────────────────────
    SELECT
        i.ccode,
        COUNT(*)                                                          AS total_items,
        SUM(CASE WHEN i.onloan IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)           AS on_loan,
        SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(s.circ_12mo, 0) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)  AS circ_12mo,
        -- dead_items: UPDATED to 3-year window (was 2 years)
        SUM(CASE WHEN (s.last_circ IS NULL
                       OR s.last_circ < DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 3 YEAR))
                 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)                                      AS dead_items,
        SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(i.issues, 0) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)     AS never_circd,
        ROUND(AVG(COALESCE(i.issues, 0)), 2)                            AS avg_lifetime_circ
    FROM items i
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT itemnumber,
               COUNT(*)       AS circ_12mo,
               MAX(datetime)  AS last_circ
        FROM statistics
        WHERE type IN ('issue', 'renew')
        GROUP BY itemnumber
    ) s ON i.itemnumber = s.itemnumber
    WHERE i.homebranch            = 'BERTWP'
      AND i.itemlost              = 0
      AND i.withdrawn             = 0
      AND COALESCE(i.notforloan, 0) = 0
    GROUP BY i.ccode
) main
LEFT JOIN (
    -- ── Weed eligible per collection ────────────────────────────────
    -- Criterion A: dead 3+ years (or never circed) after 4-yr protection
    -- Criterion B: nonfiction copyright 15+ years AND < 3 lifetime checkouts
    SELECT i.ccode, COUNT(*) AS weed_eligible
    FROM items i
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT itemnumber, MAX(datetime) AS last_circ
        FROM statistics
        WHERE type IN ('issue', 'renew')
        GROUP BY itemnumber
    ) s ON i.itemnumber = s.itemnumber
    LEFT JOIN biblioitems bi ON bi.biblionumber = i.biblionumber
    WHERE i.homebranch  = 'BERTWP'
      AND i.itemlost    = 0
      AND i.withdrawn   = 0
      AND COALESCE(i.notforloan, 0) = 0
      AND i.dateaccessioned < DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 4 YEAR)
      AND (
            -- Criterion A
            (s.last_circ IS NULL
             OR s.last_circ < DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 3 YEAR))
            OR
            -- Criterion B: UPDATED to 15-year copyright threshold (was 10)
            (i.ccode IN ('ANONFIC', 'JNONFIC', 'YANONFIC')
             AND bi.publicationyear IS NOT NULL
             AND bi.publicationyear < YEAR(CURDATE()) - 15
             AND COALESCE(i.issues, 0) < 3)
          )
    GROUP BY i.ccode
) weed ON main.ccode = weed.ccode
LEFT JOIN (
    -- ── Missing / lost per collection ───────────────────────────────
    SELECT ccode, COUNT(*) AS missing_lost
    FROM items
    WHERE homebranch = 'BERTWP'
      AND itemlost   > 0
    GROUP BY ccode
) lost ON main.ccode = lost.ccode
ORDER BY main.ccode;
-- Total active items across all health tile collections
SELECT 'total_items' AS metric, COUNT(*) AS value
FROM items
WHERE homebranch = 'BERTWP'
  AND itemlost   = 0
  AND withdrawn  = 0
  AND COALESCE(notforloan, 0) = 0
  AND ccode NOT IN ('AREF', 'YAREF', 'JREF', 'LOCALHIST')
UNION ALL
-- DoA Risk: 2–6 months old, 0 checkouts, excluding magazines
SELECT 'doa_risk', COUNT(*)
FROM items
WHERE homebranch = 'BERTWP'
  AND ccode NOT IN ('APERIOD', 'JPERIOD')
  AND dateaccessioned >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 6 MONTH)
  AND dateaccessioned <  DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 2 MONTH)
  AND COALESCE(issues, 0) = 0
  AND COALESCE(notforloan, 0) = 0
  AND withdrawn = 0 AND itemlost = 0
UNION ALL
-- Weed Candidates: global count (15-yr copyright threshold)
SELECT 'weed_candidates', COUNT(*)
FROM items i
JOIN biblio b ON i.biblionumber = b.biblionumber
WHERE i.homebranch = 'BERTWP'
  AND COALESCE(i.notforloan, 0) = 0
  AND i.withdrawn = 0 AND i.itemlost = 0
  AND i.ccode NOT IN ('APERIOD', 'JPERIOD')
  AND i.dateaccessioned < DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 4 YEAR)
  AND (
        i.datelastborrowed IS NULL
        OR i.datelastborrowed < DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 3 YEAR)
        OR (i.ccode IN ('ANONFIC', 'JNONFIC', 'YANONFIC')
            AND CAST(b.copyrightdate AS UNSIGNED) < YEAR(CURDATE()) - 15
            AND COALESCE(i.issues, 0) < 3)
      )
UNION ALL
-- High Use: 50+ lifetime checkouts
SELECT 'high_use', COUNT(*)
FROM items
WHERE homebranch = 'BERTWP'
  AND COALESCE(issues, 0) >= 50
  AND COALESCE(notforloan, 0) = 0
  AND withdrawn = 0;
Dewey Analytics
Nonfiction circulation by Dewey 100-range & 3-digit class
Updated Quarterly or As Needed: Query E4 below generates the main Dewey table (items, checkouts, dead %, signals); Queries E1, E2, E3 (ANONFIC, JNONFIC, YANONFIC) add the borrower breadth data shown in each class sub-table.
Metabase Query Reference

Run in Metabase, export as CSV, then share with Claude to update the dashboard.

Borrower breadth analysis at the 3-digit Dewey class level for Adult Nonfiction. Reveals whether a class's circulation is driven by broad community demand or repeat-patron inflation. Classes with fewer than 5 items are excluded. Run in Metabase, export as CSV, and share with Claude to update the dashboard.
SELECT
    CAST(LEFT(REGEXP_SUBSTR(i.itemcallnumber, '[0-9]+'), 3) AS UNSIGNED) AS dewey_class,
    COUNT(DISTINCT i.itemnumber)                         AS total_items,
    ROUND(AVG(COALESCE(i.issues, 0)), 2)                AS avg_lifetime_circ,
    SUM(COALESCE(i.issues, 0))                           AS total_circs,
    COUNT(DISTINCT s.borrowernumber)                     AS unique_borrowers,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN i.issues > 0
          THEN i.itemnumber END)                         AS items_circulated,
    ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN i.issues > 0
          THEN i.itemnumber END)
          / COUNT(DISTINCT i.itemnumber) * 100, 1)      AS pct_items_circulated,
    ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT s.borrowernumber)
          / NULLIF(SUM(COALESCE(i.issues, 0)), 0), 3)   AS borrower_breadth
FROM items i
LEFT JOIN statistics s
    ON  s.itemnumber = i.itemnumber
    AND s.type = 'issue'
WHERE i.homebranch              = 'BERTWP'
  AND i.ccode                   = 'ANONFIC'
  AND i.itemlost                = 0
  AND i.withdrawn               = 0
  AND COALESCE(i.notforloan, 0) = 0
  AND i.itemcallnumber REGEXP '[0-9]'
GROUP BY CAST(LEFT(REGEXP_SUBSTR(i.itemcallnumber, '[0-9]+'), 3) AS UNSIGNED)
HAVING total_items >= 5
ORDER BY dewey_class;
Borrower breadth analysis at the 3-digit Dewey class level for Juvenile Nonfiction. Note: JNONFIC call numbers are prefixed (e.g. "E 001.944 ATK") — the query uses REGEXP_SUBSTR to extract the numeric Dewey class regardless of prefix. Run in Metabase, export as CSV, and share with Claude to update the dashboard.
SELECT
    CAST(LEFT(REGEXP_SUBSTR(i.itemcallnumber, '[0-9]+'), 3) AS UNSIGNED) AS dewey_class,
    COUNT(DISTINCT i.itemnumber)                         AS total_items,
    ROUND(AVG(COALESCE(i.issues, 0)), 2)                AS avg_lifetime_circ,
    SUM(COALESCE(i.issues, 0))                           AS total_circs,
    COUNT(DISTINCT s.borrowernumber)                     AS unique_borrowers,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN i.issues > 0
          THEN i.itemnumber END)                         AS items_circulated,
    ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN i.issues > 0
          THEN i.itemnumber END)
          / COUNT(DISTINCT i.itemnumber) * 100, 1)      AS pct_items_circulated,
    ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT s.borrowernumber)
          / NULLIF(SUM(COALESCE(i.issues, 0)), 0), 3)   AS borrower_breadth
FROM items i
LEFT JOIN statistics s
    ON  s.itemnumber = i.itemnumber
    AND s.type = 'issue'
WHERE i.homebranch              = 'BERTWP'
  AND i.ccode                   = 'JNONFIC'
  AND i.itemlost                = 0
  AND i.withdrawn               = 0
  AND COALESCE(i.notforloan, 0) = 0
  AND i.itemcallnumber REGEXP '[0-9]'
GROUP BY CAST(LEFT(REGEXP_SUBSTR(i.itemcallnumber, '[0-9]+'), 3) AS UNSIGNED)
HAVING total_items >= 5
ORDER BY dewey_class;
Borrower breadth analysis at the 3-digit Dewey class level for YA Nonfiction. Run in Metabase, export as CSV, and share with Claude to update the dashboard.
SELECT
    CAST(LEFT(REGEXP_SUBSTR(i.itemcallnumber, '[0-9]+'), 3) AS UNSIGNED) AS dewey_class,
    COUNT(DISTINCT i.itemnumber)                         AS total_items,
    ROUND(AVG(COALESCE(i.issues, 0)), 2)                AS avg_lifetime_circ,
    SUM(COALESCE(i.issues, 0))                           AS total_circs,
    COUNT(DISTINCT s.borrowernumber)                     AS unique_borrowers,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN i.issues > 0
          THEN i.itemnumber END)                         AS items_circulated,
    ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN i.issues > 0
          THEN i.itemnumber END)
          / COUNT(DISTINCT i.itemnumber) * 100, 1)      AS pct_items_circulated,
    ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT s.borrowernumber)
          / NULLIF(SUM(COALESCE(i.issues, 0)), 0), 3)   AS borrower_breadth
FROM items i
LEFT JOIN statistics s
    ON  s.itemnumber = i.itemnumber
    AND s.type = 'issue'
WHERE i.homebranch              = 'BERTWP'
  AND i.ccode                   = 'YANONFIC'
  AND i.itemlost                = 0
  AND i.withdrawn               = 0
  AND COALESCE(i.notforloan, 0) = 0
  AND i.itemcallnumber REGEXP '[0-9]'
GROUP BY CAST(LEFT(REGEXP_SUBSTR(i.itemcallnumber, '[0-9]+'), 3) AS UNSIGNED)
HAVING total_items >= 5
ORDER BY dewey_class;
Feeds the main Dewey table below: items, average lifetime checkouts, dead %, on-shelf % and the Strong / Moderate / Hold / Weed signals for every 100-range and 3-digit class. One query covers Adult, Juvenile and YA Nonfiction. E1–E3 only add the borrower-breadth figures. (Design doc §5.6.) Run in Metabase, export as CSV, and share with Claude to update the dashboard.
SELECT
  i.ccode,
  CAST(REGEXP_SUBSTR(i.itemcallnumber, '[0-9]+') AS UNSIGNED)
    DIV 100 * 100                        AS dewey_100,
  CAST(REGEXP_SUBSTR(i.itemcallnumber, '[0-9]+') AS UNSIGNED)
    DIV 1   * 1                          AS dewey_class,
  COUNT(*)                               AS items,
  ROUND(AVG(COALESCE(i.issues,0)),2)     AS avg_lifetime_circ,
  SUM(CASE WHEN s.last_circ IS NULL
       OR s.last_circ < DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 2 YEAR)
       THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)                AS dead_items,
  ROUND(100 * SUM(CASE WHEN s.last_circ IS NULL
       OR s.last_circ < DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 2 YEAR)
       THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 1) AS dead_pct,
  SUM(CASE WHEN i.onloan IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS on_shelf,
  ROUND(100 * SUM(CASE WHEN i.onloan IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
       / COUNT(*), 1)                    AS on_shelf_pct
FROM items i
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT itemnumber, MAX(datetime) AS last_circ
  FROM statistics WHERE type IN ('issue','renew')
  GROUP BY itemnumber) s ON i.itemnumber = s.itemnumber
WHERE i.homebranch = 'BERTWP'
AND i.ccode IN ('ANONFIC','JNONFIC','YANONFIC')
AND i.itemlost = 0 AND i.withdrawn = 0
AND COALESCE(i.notforloan,0) = 0
AND REGEXP_SUBSTR(i.itemcallnumber, '[0-9]+') IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY i.ccode, dewey_100, dewey_class
HAVING items >= 2
ORDER BY i.ccode, dewey_100, dewey_class;

Collection Analysis
Weed candidates, DoA risk items, high-use titles, & duplicates
Updated Quarterly or As Needed: Queries D1–D4, F, and G below generate the working item lists in the tabs below.
Metabase Query Reference

Generates working item lists for: Weed candidates, DoA Risk items, High-use items, Duplicates, Dead Items.

Item-level list of weed candidates. Criterion A: no checkout in 3+ years (all collections, 4-yr protection window). Criterion B: nonfiction with copyright 15+ years and fewer than 3 lifetime checkouts. Excludes on-loan, lost, withdrawn. Limit 500, sorted oldest-last-circ first.
SELECT
    b.title,
    b.author,
    i.itemcallnumber     AS call_number,
    i.ccode              AS collection,
    i.datelastborrowed   AS last_circ,
    i.barcode
FROM items i
JOIN biblio b ON b.biblionumber = i.biblionumber
LEFT JOIN biblioitems bi ON bi.biblionumber = i.biblionumber
WHERE i.homebranch       = 'BERTWP'
  AND i.itemlost         = 0
  AND i.withdrawn        = 0
  AND i.notforloan       = 0
  AND i.onloan           IS NULL
  AND i.dateaccessioned  < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 4 YEAR)
  AND (
        (i.datelastborrowed IS NULL
         OR i.datelastborrowed < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 3 YEAR))
        OR
        (i.ccode IN ('ANONFIC', 'JNONFIC', 'YANONFIC')
         AND bi.publicationyear IS NOT NULL
         AND bi.publicationyear < YEAR(NOW()) - 15
         AND COALESCE(i.issues, 0) < 3)
      )
ORDER BY i.datelastborrowed ASC
LIMIT 500;
Items accessioned 2–6 months ago with zero checkouts. New items that aren’t moving — candidates for relocation, display promotion, or early review. Excludes magazines (Adult and Juv. Periodicals). Same rules as the DoA Risk stat box (Query B), so the list and box match. Limit 500.
SELECT
    b.title,
    b.author,
    i.itemcallnumber   AS call_number,
    i.ccode            AS collection,
    i.dateaccessioned  AS date_added,
    i.barcode
FROM items i
JOIN biblio b ON b.biblionumber = i.biblionumber
WHERE i.homebranch = 'BERTWP'
  AND i.ccode NOT IN ('APERIOD', 'JPERIOD')
  AND i.dateaccessioned >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 6 MONTH)
  AND i.dateaccessioned <  DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 2 MONTH)
  AND COALESCE(i.issues, 0) = 0
  AND COALESCE(i.notforloan, 0) = 0
  AND i.withdrawn = 0
  AND i.itemlost  = 0
ORDER BY i.dateaccessioned ASC
LIMIT 500;
Items with 50+ lifetime checkouts (Koha’s running total, including pre-Koha history) — same rule as the High Use stat box (Query B). High-demand titles that may need replacement copies or repair review. Shows the top 50 in each collection, so every collection is represented — use the collection filter to view one at a time.
SELECT title, author, call_number, collection,
       lifetime_checkouts, last_circ, barcode
FROM (
    SELECT
        b.title,
        b.author,
        i.itemcallnumber          AS call_number,
        i.ccode                   AS collection,
        COALESCE(i.issues, 0)     AS lifetime_checkouts,
        i.datelastborrowed        AS last_circ,
        i.barcode,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY i.ccode
                           ORDER BY COALESCE(i.issues, 0) DESC) AS rank_in_collection
    FROM items i
    JOIN biblio b ON b.biblionumber = i.biblionumber
    WHERE i.homebranch = 'BERTWP'
      AND COALESCE(i.issues, 0) >= 50
      AND COALESCE(i.notforloan, 0) = 0
      AND i.withdrawn = 0
) ranked
WHERE rank_in_collection <= 50
ORDER BY collection, lifetime_checkouts DESC;
Item-level view of call numbers with 3+ copies in the same collection. Groups by call number and volume (enumchron), so each volume of a series appears as its own row. Includes Copies and On Loan columns to judge whether duplicates are justified by demand. Excludes Library of Things, Periodicals, Chinese collection, and Book Club Kit. Threshold raised from 2+ to 3+ in Nov 2026 so the list is complete (2+ exceeded the row limit and was cut off alphabetically). Limit 1000 as a safety cap.
SELECT
    CONCAT(
        b.title,
        IF(b.part_number IS NOT NULL AND b.part_number != '', CONCAT(' ', b.part_number), ''),
        IF(b.part_name   IS NOT NULL AND b.part_name   != '', CONCAT(' ', b.part_name),   '')
    )                                                          AS title,
    b.author,
    i.itemcallnumber                                           AS call_number,
    i.enumchron                                                AS volume,
    i.ccode                                                    AS collection,
    COUNT(i.itemnumber)                                        AS copies,
    SUM(CASE WHEN i.onloan IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)     AS on_loan
FROM items i
JOIN biblio b ON b.biblionumber = i.biblionumber
WHERE i.homebranch = 'BERTWP'
  AND i.itemlost   = 0
  AND i.withdrawn  = 0
  AND i.notforloan = 0
  AND i.ccode NOT IN ('LIBOFTHNGS', 'APERIOD', 'JPERIOD')
  AND i.itemcallnumber NOT LIKE 'CHINESE%'
  AND i.location != 'BOOKDSCSSN'
GROUP BY i.biblionumber, b.title, b.part_number, b.part_name, b.author, i.ccode, i.itemcallnumber, i.enumchron
HAVING COUNT(i.itemnumber) >= 3
ORDER BY copies DESC, b.title ASC
LIMIT 1000;
Main circulating collections only (fiction, nonfiction, media). Excludes items added within the last 4 years, currently checked out, lost, or withdrawn. Load results into the dashboard as CD_DEAD_DATA.
SELECT
  i.barcode              AS bc,
  b.title                AS t,
  b.author               AS a,
  i.itemcallnumber       AS c,
  i.ccode                AS col,
  i.datelastborrowed     AS lc
FROM items i
JOIN biblio b ON b.biblionumber = i.biblionumber
WHERE i.homebranch       = 'BERTWP'
  AND i.itemlost         = 0
  AND i.withdrawn        = 0
  AND i.notforloan       = 0
  AND i.onloan           IS NULL
  AND i.ccode IN ('ANONFIC','AFIC','JNONFIC','JFIC','YANONFIC','YAFIC','AMEDIA','JMEDIA','YAMEDIA')
  AND i.dateaccessioned  < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 4 YEAR)
  AND (
    i.datelastborrowed IS NULL
    OR i.datelastborrowed < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 5 YEAR)
  )
ORDER BY i.ccode, i.itemcallnumber
Items currently marked as lost in Koha (itemlost > 0). Load results into the dashboard as CD_MISSING_DATA.
SELECT
  i.barcode              AS bc,
  b.title                AS t,
  b.author               AS a,
  i.itemcallnumber       AS c,
  i.ccode                AS col,
  i.datelastseen         AS dl
FROM items i
JOIN biblio b ON b.biblionumber = i.biblionumber
WHERE i.homebranch = 'BERTWP'
  AND i.itemlost > 0
ORDER BY i.ccode, i.itemcallnumber

What this list shows
Top 50 items in each collection, ranked by lifetime checkouts. Only items with 50 or more lifetime checkouts qualify, so smaller collections may show fewer than 50.
Lifetime checkouts is Koha’s running total for each copy, including checkouts carried over from before the March 2025 move to Koha.
Not included: not-for-loan and withdrawn items.
The High Use box on the Overview page counts every item with 50+ checkouts; this list is the top of each collection. Use the collection filter to compare within one collection.
Use it for: worn copies to replace or repair, and titles that may need additional copies.
Source: Metabase Query D3 (see Query Reference above).
Title Author Call # Collection Lifetime Checkouts Last Circ Barcode
What this list shows
Every title with 3 or more copies of the same call number and volume in the same collection. Each volume of a series is its own row. Titles with only 2 copies are not listed.
Copies counts circulating copies; On Loan is how many are checked out right now.
Not included: Library of Things, periodicals, the Chinese collection, Book Club Kits, and lost, withdrawn or not-for-loan copies.
Use it for: spotting extra copies to withdraw — many copies with few on loan suggests more copies than demand.
Source: Metabase Query D4 (see Query Reference above).
